policy: referencePolicy (instrumented mirror, final state checked equal on every seed)
quantiles: R-7 linear; censored (unreached) values rank last

T1.target: At least 95% clear 1-5 within 600 open seconds

T4a.target: median pulls to full roster 70–90 (10k cohort; v1.3 band 100–140)

T5.target: Every no-input starter seed remains below 1-8 after 1 open hour

T6.target: Every farm clear takes 20–40 seconds (1-tick / 0.05 s epsilon)

T7.target: Every non-boss clears within 2700 open seconds of first attempt

T8.target: luck bounds: no 60-pull window without Legendary, no 20 dupes in a row (pre-roster); first Legendary gear by roll 40, then ≤ 100-roll gaps; goblin ≤ 300 clears; offline roll units ≥ 50% of online chest rate
T8.note: Recruit pity (CR-14-01/02) and gear Fortune (CR-14-03) are guaranteed when their rules are on; offline50pct counts Expedition Chests × 4 roll units (CR-14-04); overall T8 cannot pass yet: goblin (CR-14-06) is not implemented, so goblin300 is unmeasured.

T9.target: median gap ≤ 3 min and p90 ≤ 5 min in every phase (d1 h0–2, h2–6, d2–5, d6–9)

T10.target: ≥ 95% of 1 h absences offer a meaningful decision on return
